en.summary: This mixed L2 cache commit includes a clear snoop-forwarding protocol fix. Intermediate forwarded snoop replies are now allowed to drain and decrement their pending counter even when the final snoop-response sink is backpressured.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says it fixes L2 cache issues.
The patch changes cache RTL control logic in snoop forwarding, bank selection, and cluster wiring.
The VX_snp_forwarder hunk corrects a ready/valid dependency that can stall coherence progress.
disqualifiers: The commit also includes simulator changes and other cache fixes outside the chosen injection point.
evidence: VX_snp_forwarder.v changes fwdin_ready from snp_rsp_ready to snp_rsp_ready || (1 != pending_cntrs[sfq_read_addr]).
VX_snp_forwarder.v changes snp_rsp_valid from fwdin_taken && last-pending to fwdin_valid && last-pending, and renames the decrement event to fwdin_fire.
VX_cache_core_req_bank_sel.v and VX_cache.v also fix ready generation to respect the selected bank's readiness.
Vortex_Cluster.v adds a single-core snoop bypass instead of always instantiating the multi-core forwarder.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A snoop forwarder that fans one coherence request out to multiple destinations must be able to consume intermediate acknowledgements before the final aggregate response is accepted. If the incoming forwarded-ack path is blocked by the readiness of the final response channel, the pending counter never drains to the terminal value and the coherence transaction can deadlock under backpressure.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A snoop request is forwarded to more than one destination and at least one intermediate forwarded response returns while the final aggregate response channel is not ready.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Tie acceptance of every forwarded response to final-response readiness instead of allowing intermediate responses to drain independently until only the last one remains.
portability_notes: This maps to any coherence forwarder that counts outstanding fanout responses.
The bug is about coupling internal acknowledgement draining to the external completion sink too early.
If the target design names the structure differently, look for a per-request pending counter and a final response valid signal.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that tracks how many forwarded snoop or invalidate responses are still outstanding for one parent request.
Make the input-ready condition for forwarded acknowledgements depend only on the final response sink being ready.
Make the final response valid depend on the forwarded acknowledgement being consumed in the same cycle, rather than merely being present when the pending count reaches one.
Keep the request fanout and pending-counter initialization unchanged.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: pending counter and ready/valid handling for forwarded snoop responses
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix lets fwdin_ready stay high for intermediate returns, decrements the pending counter on fwdin_fire, and asserts snp_rsp_valid when the last pending response is present instead of only when it is simultaneously consumed.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Change fwdin_ready back to snp_rsp_ready, decrement the counter only on the old fwdin_taken event, and make snp_rsp_valid depend on fwdin_taken rather than fwdin_valid.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Under snoop-response backpressure, intermediate forwarded acknowledgements stop draining, pending counters remain nonterminal, and the L2 coherence path can stall or deadlock.
evidence_for_injection: The fix changes only the protocol conditions around when forwarded responses are accepted and when the final response is declared valid.
The pending counter logic makes the mechanism explicit and easy to reverse.
The other hunks in the commit confirm the overall patch is about L2 control correctness, not style.
notes: The bank-ready and single-core bypass hunks are also real correctness fixes, but the snoop-forwarder mutation is the cleanest portable injection target.
This bug is especially likely to reproduce when coherence traffic sees backpressure on the aggregated response channel.

zh.summary: 这个混合 L2 cache 提交中包含一处明确的 snoop-forwarding 协议修复。修复后，即使最终 snoop-response 输出端被背压，中间转发回来的 snoop 应答也可以继续被接收并递减 pending 计数。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明修复的是 L2 cache 问题。
补丁修改了 snoop forwarding、bank 选择以及 cluster 连线等 cache RTL 控制逻辑。
VX_snp_forwarder 这一处修正了会阻塞一致性前进的 ready/valid 依赖。
disqualifiers: 该提交还包含 simulator 改动以及其他 cache 修复，不都属于本次选定的注入点。
evidence: VX_snp_forwarder.v 把 fwdin_ready 从 snp_rsp_ready 改为 snp_rsp_ready || (1 != pending_cntrs[sfq_read_addr])。
VX_snp_forwarder.v 把 snp_rsp_valid 从 fwdin_taken && 最后一项 改成了 fwdin_valid && 最后一项，并把计数递减事件改为 fwdin_fire。
VX_cache_core_req_bank_sel.v 和 VX_cache.v 也修复了 ready 生成，使其真正受选中 bank 的 ready 约束。
Vortex_Cluster.v 为单核场景增加了 snoop 直通旁路，而不是始终实例化多核 forwarder。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 一个把一致性请求扇出到多个目的端的 snoop forwarder，必须能够在最终聚合响应被接收之前，先消费中间返回的应答。如果转发应答输入路径被错误地绑定到最终响应通道的 ready，上游的 pending 计数就无法先降到末值，整个一致性事务在背压下可能死锁。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 多目的 snoop-forward 完成计数
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个 snoop 请求被转发到多个目的端，并且在最终聚合响应输出端尚未 ready 时，中间某个转发应答已经返回。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把所有转发应答的接收都绑定到最终响应通道 ready，而不是允许中间应答在仅剩最后一个前独立排空。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何需要统计 fanout 应答数量的一致性 forwarder。
缺陷本质是过早把内部应答排空与外部完成出口耦合在一起。
如果目标设计名称不同，寻找“每请求 pending 计数器”和“最终响应 valid”即可。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到负责统计一个父请求还剩多少个转发 snoop/invalidate 响应未返回的逻辑。
让转发应答输入端的 ready 只依赖最终响应输出端是否 ready。
让最终响应 valid 再次依赖“最后一个转发应答在本周期被消费”，而不是只要该应答到达且 pending 为 1 就拉高。
保持请求扇出逻辑和 pending 计数初始化不变。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 转发 snoop 响应的 pending 计数与 ready/valid 处理
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复允许中间返回时保持 fwdin_ready 为高，在 fwdin_fire 时递减 pending 计数，并在最后一个响应出现时拉高 snp_rsp_valid，而不是要求其被同周期消费。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 fwdin_ready 改回 snp_rsp_ready，只在旧的 fwdin_taken 事件上递减计数，并让 snp_rsp_valid 再次依赖 fwdin_taken 而不是 fwdin_valid。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 当 snoop 响应输出端出现背压时，中间转发回来的应答无法继续排空，pending 计数停留在非终值，L2 一致性路径可能停滞甚至死锁。
evidence_for_injection: 修复只改变了转发应答何时被接收、以及最终响应何时声明 valid 的协议条件。
pending 计数器逻辑把缺陷机理表达得非常直接，也便于逆向注入。
该提交里的其他 hunk 也说明整个改动都围绕 L2 控制正确性，而不是样式整理。
notes: bank-ready 和单核旁路的改动也属于真实正确性修复，但 snoop-forwarder 是最干净、最可移植的注入点。
该缺陷尤其容易在聚合响应通道被背压时复现。
